title: Record that the channel word leaves the coefficient at 1/2
body:
## Summary
- The native channel witness is one program of 4,058 events with opcodes `add`, `transport`, `zero`, `copy` and `erase`. Its expected scope says it contains no `I-G/2` side correction.
- `X0` enters `Y34` at event 2815 with coefficient `1/2` and keeps that value through the last event.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. Pull requests #3363 and #3365 are unchanged.
